tool_about: VoxelSpace renders an original procedural height map with its column renderer. Three camera headings are computed directly without the bundled game maps. The driver supplies deterministic inputs and reads the actual engine output. It does not replace the original computation. The original HTML script runs without its final UI Init() call; the original Render() writes the captured pixel buffer. Terrain and colors are generated locally.
